nb1-04-peeking-vs-betting.png.caption: A BARGAIN/PPRM betting-wealth path crossing its certification line, next to the same anytime-valid statistic vs. naive repeated-CI peeking: peeking inflates false rejections from ~3.5% at one look to 19.1% after 40 looks, the betting statistic stays at 3.3%.

nb1-07-pprm-drift-monitor.png.caption: PPRM's harmful-shift monitor: a running-risk stream with SRM/PPRM lower bounds, time-to-alarm by predictor quality, null false-alarm control, and the analytic tau_PP/tau_S delay-ratio heatmap with Proposition A.1's boundary overlaid.

nb2-01-rule-tier-diagnostics.png.caption: Rule-tier decision (pos/neg/unresolved) by latent class, next to the rule-score histogram split by true label -- shows exactly where the keyword taxonomy can and can't separate substantive GenAI work from decoration.

nb3-02-bargain-certification.png.caption: Which cascade thresholds BARGAIN can certify (rules' agreement with the LLM vs. the agreement required for T=0.9, delta=0.1), and the resulting accuracy of four routing policies against both the LLM oracle and the known truth.
